subject: MuZero hardening — kickoff
body:
Hi Ivo,

Kickoff for the MuZero hardening effort. Our open-source implementation of the MuZero pseudocode runs on SEED RL and ships two environments — tictactoe and atari — plus a muzero agent that plugs into the standard seed_rl scripts. Today it's research-grade; several teams want planning-with-a-learned-model as a capability but nobody trusts the current state of the harness for anything load-bearing.

Goal for the half: a supported MuZero that (1) passes a deterministic tictactoe convergence test in CI, (2) trains distributed on the atari environment with published reference configs, (3) documents the learned-model planning knobs (simulations per move, unroll depth) so users don't cargo-cult them.

Milestones: CI gate by 03-06, single-machine atari validation by early April, distributed run and readout by 05-18.

Staffing and compute from you, please.

Ulla
